_comment: Tier -> model id. Phases reference a TIER, never a model id, so re-tiering the whole pipeline is one edit here. Ids verified against the Claude 5 family (Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5).
_comment_narrator: The Slack voice. Runs once per milestone on a JSON artifact — never on raw phase output, so a phase that read a secret cannot narrate it into the channel.
_comment_overrides: phase name -> tier, wins over config/phases.json. For one-off experiments; keep it empty in normal operation so phases.json stays the single source of truth.
